caption: NASA CERES SYN1deg (via POWER) AOD_55_ADJ · 2002–2025 · Sen's slope of the December to February mean of each year in each 2° square. Strong colour: passes the map-wide test for false alarms (Mann-Kendall with memory correction, q = 0.05). This map enlarges areas near the poles.

mean of December to February in each year 2002–2025 (December counts towards the next year) in each 2° square

provenance.caveat: Data: NASA CERES SYN1deg, built from satellite measurements, about 100 km squares (the map averages them into 2° squares). The trend is a straight line through 2001–2025; it shows what changed, not why. The record is 25 years long, shorter than the 30 years usually used to describe a climate.
